title: Yeasty Quick British Challots Spotted Dick
description: A quick-fix British dish featuring crumbly, yeast-based challots, braised in a sweet and savory braise, served in a biodegradable agave leaf wrapper.
instructions: Knead the challot mixture for 10 minutes until it forms a sticky dough.
Place the dough in a greased bowl and let it rise in a warm, draft-free place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place the disks into the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the disks are baking, mix together the braise ingredients and cook over medium heat until the liquid has reduced by half.
Once the disks are done, let them cool slightly before serving them in agave leaf wrappers with the warm braise spooned over the top.
